"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function InlineDeleteConfirm({ label = "record", pending, error, onConfirm }: {
  label?: string
  pending: boolean
  error: Error | null
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void>
}) {
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false)
  if (!confirming) return <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}>Delete {label}</Button>
  return <fieldset className="space-y-3" aria-label={`Confirm deletion of ${label}`}>
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-2"><span className="mr-2 text-sm font-medium">Delete this {label}?</span><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="destructive" size="sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => void onConfirm()}>{pending ? "Deleting…" : "Confirm delete"}</Button></div>
    {error ? <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertDescription>{error.message}</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}
  </fieldset>
}
